text:
tasha: Hi folks, followed the JS quickstart and my first call returns 400 with body {"error":"org_setup_incomplete","message":"organization admin must accept terms"}. Quickstart sample keeps retrying and CI shows long hangs. Anyone seen this?

ben: Can you paste the curl/SDK call and SDK version?

tasha: curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Node SDK: @redwood/sdk v1.4.0

anya: This is a new control-plane check: org must accept updated terms for legal regions. The annoying bit: node-sdk v1.4.0 has a retry-on-4xx regression that turns this into a 30s hang. Workaround: set env REDWOOD_RETRY_ON_4XX=0 or upgrade to v1.4.2-beta which fixes it.

infra-bot: Created RED-6233: node-sdk retry regression on client errors; assigned to @anya. Linked docs ticket D-1137 to add quickstart note.

ben: Quick short-term fix for the sample app: call GET /v1/org/status at startup and surface a clear message if status.requires_terms == true. That avoids retries masking the root cause.

tasha: Confirmed upgrade to v1.4.2-beta fixes the hang. Also had admin accept terms; first request succeeded. I'll open a tiny PR to add the org/status check to the quickstart sample.

anya: We'll backport the patch and add the env tip to the docs. Closing here once PRs land. :thumbsup:
